# An effect's list change events, run on every compiled target and on the
# interpreter, which is what they are held to.
#
# testdata/effect_changes.txtar is the code. The tests pin what a compiled queue
# could get wrong: the order the writes were made in (testOrder), the index a
# write read against the list as it stood then (testOrder's set), the removed
# item read before the removal (testOrder), a write no handler describes
# reaching @update after the changes (testReplace, testPartial), an
# out-of-range insert or remove reporting nothing (testOutOfRange), the element
# as each write left it rather than as the handler ends (testSetTwice), a
# field key's sibling reporting nothing (testField), a test's own write
# (testHarness), none to a bracket the tree no longer holds (testGated), and
# under a loop each copy reporting what reached its own element -- a list
# mutation of what the loop walks reaching the copies it moved
# (testPerCopy*).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

[gtk4] sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
[gtk4] stdout 'PASS'
[gtk4] ! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

struct Holder {
    items list[int]
    other int = 0
}

struct Item {
    n int = 0
}

component changes ui.node {
    var xs list[int] = [10, 20]
    var log list[string] = []

    effect(
        on = xs,
        @update(v) {
            log.push("update {v.length()}")
        },
        @insert(at, item) {
            log.push("insert {at} {item}")
        },
        @remove(at, item) {
            log.push("remove {at} {item}")
        },
        @set(at, item) {
            log.push("set {at} {item}")
        },
        @clear {
            log.push("clear")
        },
    )

    func pushRemoveSet() {
        xs.push(30)
        xs.remove(0)
        xs[1] = 99
    }

    func insertAt(i int, x int) {
        xs.insert(i, x)
    }

    func outOfRange() {
        xs.insert(9, 1)
        xs.remove(-1)
        xs.remove(5)
    }

    func bump() {
        for var k, &x = xs {
            if k == 1 {
                x += 1
            }
        }
    }

    func clearAll() {
        xs.clear()
    }

    func swapAll() {
        xs.push(1)
        xs = [7]
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testOrder(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.pushRemoveSet()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 2 30,remove 0 10,set 1 99")
}

func testInsert(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.insertAt(1, 15)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 1 15")
}

func testOutOfRange(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.outOfRange()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "")
}

func testThroughARef(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.bump()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "set 1 21")
}

func testClear(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.clearAll()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "clear")
}

func testReplace(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.swapAll()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 2 1,update 1")
}

func testHarness(t test.Test, c changes) {
    c.xs.push(5)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 2 5")
    c.xs[0] = 4
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 2 5,set 0 4")
}

component partial ui.node {
    var xs list[int] = [1]
    var log list[string] = []

    effect(
        on = xs,
        @update(v) {
            log.push("update {v.length()}")
        },
        @insert(at, item) {
            log.push("insert {at}")
        },
    )

    func pushThenRemove() {
        xs.push(2)
        xs.remove(0)
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testPartial(t test.Test, c partial) {
    c.pushThenRemove()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 1,update 1")
}

component field ui.node {
    var h = Holder{items=[1]}
    var log list[string] = []

    effect(
        on = h.items,
        @update {
            log.push("update")
        },
        @insert(at, item) {
            log.push("insert {at} {item}")
        },
        @set(at, item) {
            log.push("set {at} {item}")
        },
    )

    func add() {
        h.items.push(2)
    }

    func poke() {
        h.items[0] = 7
    }

    func sibling() {
        h.other = 3
    }

    func swap() {
        h = Holder{items=[5]}
    }

    ui.text #out(value = "{h.items.length()} {log.join(",")}")
}

func testField(t test.Test, c field) {
    c.add()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "2 insert 1 2")
    c.poke()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "2 insert 1 2,set 0 7")
    c.sibling()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "2 insert 1 2,set 0 7")
    c.swap()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1 insert 1 2,set 0 7,update")
}

component twice ui.node {
    var xs list[Item] = [Item{}]
    var log list[string] = []

    effect(
        on = xs,
        @update {},
        @set(at, item) {
            log.push("set {at} {item.n}")
        },
    )

    func setTwice() {
        xs[0].n = 1
        xs[0].n = 2
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testSetTwice(t test.Test, c twice) {
    c.setTwice()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "set 0 1,set 0 2")
}

component gated ui.node {
    var on = true
    var xs list[int] = []
    var log list[string] = []

    if on {
        effect(
            on = xs,
            @update {},
            @insert(at, item) {
                log.push("insert {at}")
            },
        )
    }

    func pushAndHide() {
        xs.push(1)
        on = false
    }

    func pushWhileHidden() {
        xs.push(2)
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testGated(t test.Test, c gated) {
    c.pushAndHide()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "")
    c.pushWhileHidden()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "")
}

struct Row {
    items list[int] = []
    n int = 0
}

component rows ui.node {
    var xs list[Row] = [Row{items=[1]}, Row{items=[2]}]
    var log list[string] = []

    ui.vbox {
        for var &x = xs {
            effect(
                on = x.items,
                @update(v) {
                    log.push("update {v.length()}")
                },
                @insert(at, item) {
                    log.push("insert {at} {item}")
                },
            )
        }
    }

    func grow() {
        xs[1].items.push(5)
    }

    func same() {
        xs[1].items = [2]
    }

    func sibling() {
        xs[0].n = 3
    }

    func append() {
        xs.push(Row{})
    }

    func insertFirst() {
        xs.insert(0, Row{items=[9, 9]})
    }

    func dropFirst() {
        xs.remove(0)
    }

    func swapAll() {
        xs = [Row{items=[7]}]
    }

    ui.text #out(value = log.join(","))
}

func testPerCopyChange(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.grow()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 1 5")
}

func testPerCopyEqualWrite(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.same()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "update 1")
}

func testPerCopySibling(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.sibling()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "")
}

func testPerCopyPush(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.append()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "")
}

func testPerCopyInsertShifts(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.insertFirst()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "update 2,update 1")
}

func testPerCopyRemoveShifts(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.dropFirst()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "update 1")
}

func testPerCopyReplace(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.swapAll()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "update 1")
}

func testPerCopyHarness(t test.Test, c rows) {
    c.xs[0].items.push(4)
    t.assert(c.out.value == "insert 1 4")
}

ui.window(title = "Changes") {
    changes
    partial
    field
    twice
    gated
    rows
}
